# Proportional Latin test font

`TableTestProportional.otf` is an ASCII-only subset of the repository's Noto
Sans CJK SC Regular fixture, renamed to Ianvs Table Test Proportional. It keeps
real proportional glyph advances so width regressions are not hidden by Ahem's
fixed-width test glyphs. It is bundled here so core tests do not depend on the
optional Mermaid package or platform-installed fonts.

- Upstream: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
- Source commit: `f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c`
- Original file: `Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf`
- Original SHA-256: `2c76254f6fc379fddfce0a7e84fb5385bb135d3e399294f6eeb6680d0365b74b`
- Copyright: © 2014–2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, retained in `OFL.txt` and font metadata.
- Subset: U+0020–U+007E, produced with FontTools 4.61.1; glyph geometry unchanged.
